description: This file defines the abstract class DataStreamWriter used for writing streaming Dataset to external storage in Apache Spark's structured streaming module. It includes methods for configuring output mode, trigger, format, partitioning, clustering, and starting streaming queries.

classes.name: DataStreamWriter
classes.description: Abstract class for configuring and starting streaming write operations in Spark structured streaming.

methods.name: outputMode
methods.description: Sets the output mode for the streaming write (append, complete, update).

methods.name: trigger
methods.description: Sets the trigger for the streaming query execution.

methods.name: queryName
methods.description: Sets a unique name for the streaming query.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Specifies the output data source format.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Partitions output data by specified columns.

methods.name: clusterBy
methods.description: Clusters output data by specified columns.

methods.name: foreach
methods.description: Sets a ForeachWriter for output processing.

methods.name: foreachBatch
methods.description: Sets a function to process each micro-batch as a Dataset.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the streaming query with output to a specified path.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the streaming query with output to a specified path, throws TimeoutException on failure.

methods.name: toTable
methods.description: Starts the streaming query with output to a table, with optional timeout.
